title: Implement visibility and effective policy evaluation
objective: Resolve defaults, managed policy, persistent overrides, session overrides, and frontmatter into model/user/executor decisions.
context: Implement the accepted hybrid design: an initial developer-role catalog snapshot, append-only upsert/revoke deltas, on-demand SKILL.md bodies, and an authoritative execution registry.
The repository is a dirty shared worktree. Preserve unrelated changes and modify only owned_files.

source_evidence.note: Codex uses a bounded initial metadata catalog and loads full SKILL.md on demand.
Claude Code supports live skill discovery, visibility overrides, and on-demand skill bodies.
Append-only conversation messages preserve the previously cached prompt prefix.

include: Define precedence managed deny > session override > persistent override > frontmatter/default.
Return separate model-visible, user-invocable, and executable decisions with reasons.
exclude: Do not modify files owned by another task.
Do not add dependencies or perform unrelated refactors.

implementation_steps: Add a full precedence matrix and managed-read-only tests.
Verify name-only never exposes descriptions and off never executes.
acceptance_criteria: Every input combination has deterministic output.
Managed restrictions cannot be relaxed by lower scopes.
Manual-only is hidden from model discovery but remains explicitly user-invocable.
risks: Conflating visibility with authorization would let prompt state become a security boundary.
dispatch_prompt: Implement and test the pure effective skill policy evaluator. Do not modify Manager, commands, or SkillTool.
notes_for_assignee: Keep the diff narrow; if a dependency contract is insufficient, report the required change to the integrator instead of editing another task's files.
